systems.tiers: launched 27 January 2026 with a pilot in Atsimondrano district; national rollout planned April to June 2026 to assign a Unique Identifier Number (NUI) to over 12 million people

systems.owner: Digital Governance Unit (UGD) of the MNDPT

note: Identity enrolment, with interoperability to the civil registry named as the UGD's task; no civil registration office system is described.
